# VBO Advertising

> Founder-led marketing consultancy and studio in Miami, serving small to mid-size businesses across South Florida.

VBO Advertising is a Miami-based marketing consultancy and studio founded by Tim Bailey. We sit between strategic consulting and full-service agency, delivering senior-level thinking and hands-on execution without the layers or overhead. Services include marketing strategy, paid media, SEO, social media, brand strategy, website design, performance analytics, creative production, and helping clients get found in both traditional search and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://www.vboadv.com/web-development): Custom builds, redesigns and Shopify stores, structured for search and measured from launch
- [Marketing Consultant](https://www.vboadv.com/marketing-consultant): Scoped consulting for owners who want a straight answer rather than a retainer
- [Fractional CMO Services](https://www.vboadv.com/fractional-cmo): What a fractional CMO does, what it costs, and when a business needs one
- [Ecommerce and Shopify Marketing](https://www.vboadv.com/ecommerce-marketing): Paid media and search run together for Shopify brands
- [AI SEO and Visibility](https://www.vboadv.com/ai-seo-agency): Getting a site read and quoted by AI assistants, not just ranked by search engines
- [AI-Enabled Marketing Agency](https://www.vboadv.com/ai-enabled-marketing): VBO's modern operational approach, comparing traditional vs AI-enabled vs AI-first agency models
- [Paid Media](https://www.vboadv.com/paid-media): Meta, Google Search, Google Shopping and Performance Max, run by the people doing the work

## Industries

- [Fashion and Apparel](https://www.vboadv.com/industries/fashion-apparel): Marketing across an apparel season, from the run-up to a drop through the long tail
- [Jewelry and Luxury Retail](https://www.vboadv.com/industries/jewelry-luxury-retail): Marketing a considered, high-value purchase with a long buying cycle
- [Food and Beverage](https://www.vboadv.com/industries/food-beverage): Marketing food and CPG brands, including what shipping and shelf life change
- [Sports and Travel](https://www.vboadv.com/industries/sports-travel): Marketing youth sports programs and travel operators, where trust comes before price
- [Local Service Businesses](https://www.vboadv.com/industries/local-service-businesses): Marketing for businesses that sell within a few miles
- [Nonprofit and Education](https://www.vboadv.com/industries/nonprofit-education): Marketing to families and funders at once, on a real budget
- [Marketing for Law Firms in Miami](https://www.vboadv.com/professional-services/law-firms): Vertical landing page for law firm marketing
- [Dental Practice Marketing in Miami](https://www.vboadv.com/professional-services/dental-practices): Vertical landing page for dental practice marketing
- [Medical Spa Marketing in Miami](https://www.vboadv.com/professional-services/med-spas): Vertical landing page for med spa and aesthetic clinic marketing
- [Financial Advisor Marketing in Miami](https://www.vboadv.com/professional-services/financial-advisors): Vertical landing page for financial advisor and RIA marketing

Miami, Miami Beach, Coral Gables, Doral, Aventura, Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, Boca Raton, West Palm Beach, plus broader South Florida and US-wide for geography-independent services.
